claim: A map that is edited by hand in the editor is changed by a tool only through a patch that names each record by index and identity and each field by its old and new value: the patch is refused if any old value differs (the editor changed it), if records were renumbered, or if the target is the baseline; appended sprites are named so a second run adds nothing; the map is written only after validation and a reparse, with a content-addressed backup of what it replaced.
evidence: projects/duke-e4l1-remake/edit_map.py: ten passes applied to E4L1-current.MAP without losing an editor save
projects/duke-e4l1-remake/tests/test_e4l1_edit.py: conflict, dry run, idempotence, interrupted report, baseline refusal
use: Never rebuild such a map; write a new pass against the live map, and resolve a conflict by revising the pass, not the map.
